risks: _import_bindings | medium | Uses info_rel.split('/')[:-1] which assumes info_rel is a relative path; may break if path is absolute or empty. | Check if info_rel is always a relative path.

_resolve_import_origin | medium | For node.level==1, parts = parts[:len(parts)] (no change); for node.level>1, parts = parts[:len(parts)-(node.level-1)]; if node.level > len(parts)+1, negative slicing yields empty list silently. | Confirm node.level never exceeds depth of info_rel.

claims.text: Defaults are routinely written as an imported constant, and this codebase imports two DIFFERENT constants under the SAME name `DEFAULT_MODEL` inside one function. Without the scope and the line number, reconciling defaults across modules would confidently compare the wrong values.
claims.why: The claim references behavior in other parts of the codebase (importing two constants named DEFAULT_MODEL) that is not present in this chunk.

claims.text: Resolves a constant Name to its value, following module imports.
claims.why: The _Resolver class implements value resolution by looking up bindings and recursing into imported modules.

observations.what: The function _name_expr returns node.slice for Subscript nodes only if slice is an expression; otherwise returns None.
_resolve_name checks for ast.Constant with str value or ast.Name with str value in consts dict.
_import_bindings uses info_rel.split('/')[:-1] to derive parent directory parts; assumes info_rel is a relative path without leading slash.
_resolve_import_origin handles node.level by slicing parts; for node.level=1, parts unchanged; for node.level>1, removes (node.level-1) trailing parts; for node.level=0, parts becomes empty list.
_Resolver.value has recursion depth limit of 4; returns (False, None) if exceeded.
_Resolver._binding filters bindings by owner span (func.lineno, func.end_lineno) and line number <= lineno; if no local, falls back to globals (owner is None).
